mpi_params._comment_mpi_pml: MPI Point-to-Point Messaging Layer: 'auto' (auto-detect UCX support), 'ucx' (force UCX), or 'ob1' (force OpenIB/TCP fallback). This remains in config because it is an MPI launch option, not an env-script setting.
mpi_params._comment_mpi_dir: Open MPI install prefix. A trailing /bin is stripped. Used for mpirun and, on Spur/Slurm, OPAL_PREFIX plus OMPI_MCA_* exports — do not put those in the env script.
mpi_params._comment_mpi_oob_port: TCP OOB interface. Bare metal: mpirun --mca btl/oob_tcp_if_include. Managed: OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include / oob_tcp_if_include generated in rccl_lib.
mpi_params._comment_ucx_tls: When user requested UCX either leave this parameter value blank for auto assignment or assign values e.g. rc,self,sm,tcp..
mpi_params._comment_net_dev_list: Leave empty for auto-detection from backend NICs, or set explicitly e.g. bnxt_re0:1,bnxt_re1:1,..

rccl._comment_env_script: RCCL/NCCL/HSA/plugin tuning only. MPI/PMIx/ORTE (OMPI_MCA_*, OPAL_PREFIX, PMIX_MCA_gds, ORTE tmpdir) are set by rccl_lib from mpi_params.

rccl_test_params._comment_rccl_collective: rccl-tests binary names in rccl_tests_dir; thresholds (results), report series and sub-test labels are keyed by these names. Optional: all_reduce_bias_perf (requires an RCCL build exporting ncclAllReduceWithBias; its JSON rows report the collective as AllReduce).
rccl_test_params._comment_rccl_test_flags: Optional rccl-tests binary flags. rccl_timeout = rccl-tests internal timer passed as -T (seconds; omit to not set). output_algo_proto_channels = boolean toggle for rccl-tests' -A 1 algorithm/protocol/channels diagnostic output.

rccl._comment_cvs_params: Perf writes per-collective files named from rccl_result_file's stem: <stem>_<collective>_<dtype>.json per data type, <stem>_<collective>.json (combined), <stem>_<collective>_aggregated.json and <stem>_<collective>_topology_check.json, so every collective in a suite run is kept. Regression writes <stem>_<collective>[_<case-hash>].json and its topology audit, so every collective and regression parameter combination is kept. Characters outside the unreserved filename set are percent-encoded in collective and data type names; configs with colliding derived perf paths fail before launch. Managed runs require writable shared storage; containers must bind-mount the result directory at the same path.

cvs_params._comment_report_ecc_delta: Set True to capture amd-smi ECC_BLOCKS (UMC, SDMA, GFX, MMHUB, PCIE_BIF, HDP, XGMI_WAFL CE/UE/DE) and log a post-test INFO table. Warns (does not fail) if any counter increases. A GPU present in only one snapshot is warned as missing data and is not reported as a counter change. A node with no usable amd-smi output is reported as NO_DATA. Uses 'amd-smi metric -g all --json' with a 60s timeout. Raw amd-smi JSON is DEBUG-only. Requires passwordless sudo (same gate as dmesg).
cvs_params._comment_report_ecc_blocks: Optional list when report_ecc_delta is True. Only these ECC blocks are captured, compared, and reported (e.g. ["UMC", "XGMI_WAFL"]). Omit or leave empty for all blocks. An unknown name fails the test. Allowed: UMC, SDMA, GFX, MMHUB, PCIE_BIF, HDP, XGMI_WAFL.
cvs_params._comment_nic_model: Selects NIC-keyed results.<nic> thresholds (thor, ainic, connectx). The shipped flat results table is used when no matching NIC/rank key exists.
cvs_params._comment_verification: Setting any verify_* flag to True enables that check and can fail the test. verify_bus_bw is False in this sample because only thor all_reduce float at 8 GiB is guide-backed: entries cover 2-16 nodes at 8 ranks per node (16-128 total ranks). Other NICs and unlisted rank counts fall back to flat examples (compared without slack at bus_bw_tolerance 1.0); a different topology with a listed total rank count resolves to the same entry and must override it. MI300X needs 304, and regression/pairwise reuse the same entries. Set it to True for qualification after checking results for your GPU, NIC and rank count.
cvs_params._comment_bus_bw_tolerance: Fraction in (0, 1] of the reference a measurement must reach; default 0.95. 1.0 enforces the published all_reduce bar exactly. With 1.0 the flat example table is also compared without slack; those values are examples, and verify_bus_bw is off by default.
cvs_params._comment_topology_check: How CVS reacts when rccl-tests' reported nodes/ranks/ranksPerNode/gpusPerRank disagree with the topology CVS launched. 'warn' (default) logs and records the mismatch; 'strict' fails the test; 'off' disables only the requested-vs-reported comparison. Checks are skipped when all rows omit topology. Use 'strict' once your rccl-tests build reports per-node rank counts correctly (see AIMVT-334).
cvs_params._comment_cvs_exec_timeout: Optional. CVS-side outer cap on the SSH-exec call wrapping mpirun (seconds, default 2400).
cvs_params._comment_pairwise_min_bw: Minimum bus BW in GB/s required for Phase 2 incremental admission (Phase 1 pairwise never gates on bandwidth, matching the original bash tool). Set to 0 to skip the BW check.
cvs_params._comment_pairwise_results_file: Local JSON file where rccl_pairwise.py persists the Phase 1 pass/fail lists and the Phase 2 final valid/excluded host lists.
cvs_params._comment_fabric: scale_out (default) uses results.<nic> then the flat table; scale_up uses only results.scale_up (see mi300x/mi350x_rccl_single_node_config.json).

rccl._comment_regression: New regression object format using NCCL_* environment variable names. Creates Cartesian product of all combinations. Channel config uses 'min-max' format (e.g., '16-16') or 'default'. Tree algorithm is automatically filtered to only run with all_reduce_perf collective.
rccl._comments_results: Both perf and regression read results here. NIC/rank entries (results.<nic>.<collective>-<data_types>-<total ranks>) take precedence over the legacy flat per-collective table, whose values are generic 2-node examples, not acceptance criteria. Each size entry is {"bus_bw": GB/s}; a measurement must reach bus_bw x cvs_params.bus_bw_tolerance. A null entry means no published threshold: with verify_bus_bw=True the collective is logged as not gated. A missing entry, or a configured message size with no result row, fails when verify_bus_bw=True.
rccl._comments_results_thor: The published MI350X/MI355X scale-out all_reduce bar is >= 350 GB/s at 8589934592 bytes for 2-16 nodes at 8 ranks per node. The table contains an exact rank key for every total rank count from 16 through 128 in steps of 8; each is enforced exactly because cvs_params.bus_bw_tolerance is 1.0. It applies when nic_model resolves to thor and data_types is ["float"]. Since keys use total ranks, another topology with the same rank count also resolves to the entry and must override it. Set every all_reduce entry to 304 for MI300X. The other nine collectives are null at the same rank counts because no bar is published. OPEN: the guide lists both 304 and 350 for MI355X; 350 is shipped pending confirmation. OPEN: the guide's "8 GB" is read as 8 GiB = 8589934592 bytes, the size rccl-tests emits with step factor 2. No MI455X/Helios bar is published; other thor platforms must override the all_reduce entries.
